objective: Useful introductions that help people leave the app, never engagement or revenue extraction.

states.forbidden_by_mission: The capability conflicts with the nonprofit product objective and must not ship.
states.absent_until_review: The capability is not implemented and may be proposed only after the named safety, privacy, and inclusion review.
states.intentionally_absent: The capability is unnecessary for the current product and is deliberately not implemented.
states.implemented_with_limits: The capability is implemented only inside the published narrow technical and product limits.

capabilities.userFacing: No ads, boosts, premium ranking, paid visibility, coins, or subscriptions that affect introductions.
capabilities.reason: Revenue must not depend on attention, exclusion, or unequal access to introductions.

capabilities.userFacing: No dwell-time, scrolling, session-frequency, notification-open, or message-volume optimization.
capabilities.reason: These proxies reward keeping people in the product instead of helping them form useful offline relationships.

capabilities.userFacing: No push-notification permission or engagement reminders. Sparse account-security email is a separate user-protective channel.
capabilities.reason: A future notification must demonstrate user benefit without coercion, presence disclosure, or engagement optimization.

capabilities.userFacing: No address-book upload, contact discovery, or social-graph matching.
capabilities.reason: Non-users cannot consent, and contact graphs create high-impact outing and relationship-inference risks.

capabilities.userFacing: No GPS permission, background location, live distance, or location history.
capabilities.reason: The current prototype uses self-entered approximate region text; any coarse-region replacement needs privacy and safety review.

capabilities.userFacing: One optional user-selected profile photo is compressed locally, shown only with the public profile, and removable at any time.
capabilities.reason: A recognizable photo is core dating-app utility, while one bounded image avoids a media feed. Camera capture, image analysis, face recognition, biometric verification, beauty scoring, and photo-based matching remain absent. Photo consent, moderation, outing risk, and secure production media storage still require review before a real-person pilot.

capabilities.userFacing: No read receipts, typing indicators, online status, last-active time, streaks, or response-pressure scoring.
capabilities.reason: Presence signals create pressure and sensitive behavioral records without improving transparent matchmaking.

capabilities.userFacing: No service worker caches private profiles, messages, sessions, or API responses.
capabilities.reason: Installable web metadata does not justify an additional persistent copy of intimate data.

capabilities.userFacing: No Face ID, fingerprint, liveness, or identity-verification permission is requested.
capabilities.reason: The app uses device-only secure storage without biometric authentication; verification needs evidence of net benefit and an exclusion analysis.

capabilities.userFacing: Android application backup is disabled; mobile session material is device-only and not migrated in backups.
capabilities.reason: A convenience backup must not silently create another recoverable copy of account authorization or pending message text.
